## 广度是最大的风险来源

10 月 30 日，美股综合风险评分为 66.9，维持防御。市场风险为 68.3，已进入防御区间。参与度风险为 61.8，处于谨慎区间。金融压力为 49.0，仍属中性，而脆弱性达到 88.6，处于压力区。

市场广度对综合评分的贡献最大。因子拥挤和泡沫因子也贡献了较多风险分数。上涨若集中在少数股票或共同因子上，一旦这些头寸同时回撤，其他股票能提供的缓冲就较小。这解释了为什么金融压力尚属中性，权益配置仍需防御。

本期 HML 估值观测已更新至 10 月 30 日，UMD 仍使用代理数据，其余输入采用最近可用值。解读 66.9 时应保留看板的暂定标记。

## 半导体跌幅扩大，强势股仍是少数

SMH 近 20 个交易日下跌 17.1%，同期落后 QQQ 9.3 个百分点。半导体与 AI 硬件综合分维持在显示下限 0，原始分已降至 −12.7。原始分揭示了显示值触底后仍在发生的走弱。

在 28 只监测股票中，仅 14% 站上 20 日均线，站上 50 日均线的比例同为 14%。需求动量和供应链确认均为 0，领导广度为 11，相对风险偏好仅为 9。少数个股仍有韧性，行业内却缺少同步修复。

同一窗口内，NXPI 上涨 6.5%，TXN 上涨 2.4%，而 INTC、TER 和 COHR 分别下跌 44.9%、38.9% 和 37.6%。分化脆弱性达到 82。观察板块见底时，需要看到更多股票收复均线，以及设备、存储和网络硬件等环节共同企稳。

## 期限溢价压缩，长端利率回落

截至 10 月 29 日，ACM 模型的 10 年期美债拟合收益率为 4.952%，其中预期短端利率分项为 4.287%，期限溢价为 0.664%。从 9 月 29 日至 10 月 29 日，拟合收益率下降 27.30 个基点。

期限溢价压缩贡献 −17.94 个基点，约占总降幅的三分之二。利率预期贡献 −9.37 个基点。两项均向下，但投资者持有长债要求的额外补偿下降更多。各分项按显示精度取整。

把窗口拉长，拟合收益率较三个月前仍高 21.41 个基点，较六个月前高 48.30 个基点，较一年前高 83.39 个基点。过去一年，预期利率分项贡献 +67.07 个基点。近期回落缓解了估值压力，长期利率环境仍比一年前更紧。

## 配置继续防御，关注两项修复

长端利率在一个月内回落，股票内部的广度和动量却没有给出同样的改善信号。当前维持防御配置，控制拥挤主题与半导体的风险敞口。

提高风险仓位前，先观察两个变化能否持续：一是市场参与面扩大、广度对风险分数的贡献下降；二是半导体相对 QQQ 的弱势缓解，并得到需求动量和供应链确认的共同支持。单周利率回落或少数龙头反弹，都不足以单独触发配置调整。

## Breadth contributes most to risk

On October 30, the composite regime risk score stood at 66.9, in Defensive territory. Market risk reached 68.3 (Defensive), while participation risk was 61.8 (Caution). Financial stress remained Neutral at 49.0. Fragility was the outlier at 88.6, in the Stress range.

Market breadth made the largest contribution to the composite. Factor crowding and the bubble factor layer also contributed materially. When leadership rests on a narrow group of stocks exposed to common factors, fewer names can cushion a simultaneous selloff. That vulnerability supports a defensive equity stance even with neutral financial stress.

The October 30 reading is provisional. The model uses an October 30 HML valuation, retains a proxy for UMD, and takes other inputs at their latest eligible dates.

## Semiconductor losses deepen

SMH fell 17.1% over 20 trading sessions, trailing QQQ by 9.3 percentage points. The semiconductor and AI hardware score stayed at its floor of zero. Its raw reading fell to −12.7, capturing further deterioration below the displayed floor.

Only 14% of the 28 monitored stocks traded above their 20-day moving average. The share above the 50-day average was also 14%. Demand momentum and supply-chain confirmation both scored zero, leadership breadth was 11 and relative risk appetite was 9. Resilience in a few names has yet to spread through the industry.

NXPI gained 6.5% and TXN gained 2.4% over the same window. INTC fell 44.9%, TER 38.9% and COHR 37.6%. Divergence fragility reached 82. Evidence of a durable turn would include more stocks reclaiming their moving averages and participation across equipment, memory and networking hardware.

## A smaller term premium drives the yield decline

The ACM fitted 10-year Treasury yield was 4.952% on October 29. Its expected short-rate component was 4.287% and its term premium was 0.664%. From September 29 to October 29, the fitted yield fell 27.30 basis points.

The term premium accounted for 17.94 basis points of the decline, roughly two-thirds of the total. Expected short rates contributed a further 9.37 basis points. Both components fell, with the larger adjustment coming from the compensation investors required to hold longer-dated debt. Displayed components are rounded.

The fitted yield was still 21.41 basis points above its level three months earlier, 48.30 above six months earlier and 83.39 above a year earlier. Expected rates accounted for 67.07 basis points of the annual increase. The monthly decline eases valuation pressure, but the rate backdrop remains tighter than a year ago.

## What would justify more equity risk?

Long yields eased over the month, while equity breadth and momentum gave little evidence of a comparable recovery. The research stance remains defensive, with exposure to crowded themes and semiconductors kept in check.

Two developments would support taking more risk: sustained improvement in participation that reduces the risk contribution from breadth, and a recovery in semiconductors relative to QQQ backed by stronger demand momentum and supply-chain confirmation. A short-lived rally in a few leaders or a decline in yields alone would leave the allocation case largely unchanged.
